from unittest.mock import patch
from Orange.widgets.data import owcolor
from Orange.widgets.data.tests import test_owcolor as public_tests
from Orange.widgets.tests.base import WidgetTest


class TestPublicOWColor(WidgetTest):
    def setUp(self):
        self.widget = self.create_widget(owcolor.OWColor)
        public_tests.TestOWColor._create_descs(self)

    def parse(self, definitions):
        with patch.object(owcolor.QMessageBox, "warning") as warning, \
             patch.object(owcolor.QMessageBox, "critical") as critical:
            self.widget._parse_var_defs(definitions)
        critical.assert_not_called()
        text = "\n".join(
            str(call[0][2] if len(call[0]) >= 3 else call[1].get("text", ""))
            for call in warning.call_args_list)
        return warning, text

    def names(self):
        return [d.name for d in self.widget.disc_descs + self.widget.cont_descs]

    def test_unused_categorical_definitions(self):
        warning, text = self.parse({"categorical": {
            "foo": {"renamed_values": {}},
            "bar": {"renamed_values": {}}}, "numeric": {}})
        warning.assert_called()
        self.assertIn("foo", text)
        self.assertIn("bar", text)
        self.assertEqual(self.names(), ["varA", "varB", "varC", "varD", "varE"])

    def test_unused_numeric_definition(self):
        warning, text = self.parse({"categorical": {}, "numeric": {"foo": {}}})
        warning.assert_called()
        self.assertIn("foo", text)
        self.assertEqual(self.names(), ["varA", "varB", "varC", "varD", "varE"])

    def test_duplicate_variable_renames(self):
        definitions = [
            {"categorical": {"varA": {"rename": "varB"}}, "numeric": {}},
            {"categorical": {"varA": {"rename": "X"}},
             "numeric": {"varD": {"rename": "X"}}},
        ]
        for case in definitions:
            with self.subTest(definitions=case):
                public_tests.TestOWColor._create_descs(self)
                warning, text = self.parse(case)
                warning.assert_called()
                self.assertIn("duplicated names", text)
                self.assertEqual(self.names(), ["varA", "varB", "varC", "varD", "varE"])

    def test_variable_name_swap(self):
        warning, _ = self.parse({
            "categorical": {"varA": {"rename": "varD"}},
            "numeric": {"varD": {"rename": "varA"}}})
        warning.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(self.names(), ["varD", "varB", "varC", "varA", "varE"])

    def test_unused_rename_preserves_valid_rename(self):
        warning, text = self.parse({
            "categorical": {"varA": {"rename": "X"}},
            "numeric": {"var not": {"rename": "X"}}})
        warning.assert_called()
        self.assertIn("var not", text)
        self.assertNotIn("duplicated names", text)
        self.assertEqual(self.names(), ["X", "varB", "varC", "varD", "varE"])
PYTEST_PUBLIC
QT_QPA_PLATFORM=minimal xvfb-run --auto-servernum .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  "$owcolor_public_tmp/test_public_contract.py::TestPublicOWColor" \
  -k 'test_unused_ or test_duplicate_variable_renames or test_variable_name_swap'
